nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Single-stage Docker build packaging the JARVIS Graph API: a read-only FastAPI service served by uvicorn on port 8000 over the dev_graph in Neo4j. Installs Python deps from requirements.txt, copies app.py, and runs the ASGI app with NEO4J_* injected at runtime.
nodes.languageNotes: Slim python:3.12 base with --no-cache-dir pip install to minimize image size; requirements are copied before app.py to leverage Docker layer caching. NEO4J_* env vars are supplied by docker-compose or the host environment rather than baked into the image.

nodes.name: python
nodes.summary: Runtime container stage built from python:3.12-slim that exposes port 8000 and launches uvicorn serving app:app, hosting the JARVIS read-only Graph API.
